summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing of AlgoForge (LeetCode-like) app. All critical flows verified: problems list with filters, theme toggle, guest problem page (Description/Editorial/Submissions-locked), language boilerplates for python/java/cpp/javascript, guest Run flow (correct->Accepted, wrong->Wrong Answer, syntax->Runtime Error with error text), stdout/console tab logging, testcase add/remove/edit, guest submit redirect to /login, invalid login toast, registration, logout, demo login, authenticated submit (correct->Accepted 6/6, wrong->Wrong Answer with failed case output/expected), submissions tab lists submissions and loads code into editor, profile page shows all widgets (solved ring, difficulty, heatmap, languages, recent submissions), guest /profile redirects to /login. Regression confirmed: POST /api/run without 'inputs' now defaults to sample tests and returns 200.

issues: Per-case stdout concatenated without newlines between cases: shows '// Case 1hello-stdout// Case 2hello-stdout...' - a line break between the case label and the log output would improve readability

action_items: (Low) Add newline/formatting between case label and stdout content in Console tab logs view (ConsolePanel.jsx)
(Doc) Note for next test agent: Monaco setValue needs ~1000-1500ms wait before clicking Run/Submit so React state (code) is updated. Otherwise rapid consecutive submits may use stale code.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx submit() depends on React 'code' state which updates via Monaco onChange; rapid programmatic setValue+click can race (noticed during test). Not a user-facing bug since humans type naturally, but consider reading from editor model at submit time for robustness.
ApiController.submit uses 'language' field in SubmitReq while frontend sends 'language' - fine. test_credentials.md should document that body field is 'language' not 'lang' (minor).
ConsolePanel console-logs rendering concatenates '// Case N' label directly with stdout content without separator.
test_credentials: demo@algoforge.dev / demo1234 (works). Registered TEST_userTS@algoforge.dev for session.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test user via /api/auth/register and new submissions for demo user on two-sum (both wrong and accepted). Not cleaned up - consider cleanup if preserving demo profile state matters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All playbook items pass. Key gotchas: (1) Monaco setValue requires >=1000ms sleep before clicking Submit so React 'code' state syncs. (2) Guest /profile redirects to /login as expected. (3) Submissions tab 'rows' are per-problem (not total). (4) Theme toggle flips html.class dark<->light. All data-testids documented in request are present and functional.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial false positive during submit test (correct code -> Wrong Answer) was due to insufficient wait between Monaco setValue and click; adding 1500ms wait before click reproduced correct behavior (Accepted 6/6). Backend /api/submit confirmed working via direct curl using language='python' field.
